news_1_body:
在泰国曼谷刚刚落幕的2026年亚洲食品博览会上，YuKoLi携全新第五代智能烹饪机器人惊艳亮相，成为全场焦点。本次展会吸引了来自东南亚、南亚和中东地区超过2000家餐饮企业参展。

第五代智能烹饪机器人是对前代产品的全面升级，搭载全新AI烹饪引擎，支持超过800道涵盖中餐、东南亚菜和西餐的菜谱。配备精密温控系统和自适应翻炒技术，该设备的烹饪一致性达标率达到99.5%，远超行业平均水平。

YuKoLi展位在整个展会期间人气旺盛，来自泰国、越南、马来西亚和印度尼西亚的200多家餐饮品牌代表亲身体验了该设备。多家连锁餐饮集团当场表达了合作意向，首批50台设备预计将在六个月内完成交付部署。

YuKoLi首席执行官在媒体采访中表示："我们的目标不仅仅是提供一款智能设备，而是为餐饮企业打造一套完整的智能厨房解决方案。通过AI技术与物联网平台的深度整合，YuKoLi帮助客户实现从备菜到出餐全流程的标准化与自动化，大幅降低人工成本的同时，确保每道菜品的高品质与一致性。"

此外，YuKoLi在展会上还发布了全新的云端管理平台，支持远程设备监控、自动化维护预警和一键菜谱更新，进一步提升商业厨房的运营效率和智能化水平。

news_2_body:
一家东南亚知名连锁餐饮品牌宣布在旗下全部86家门店大规模部署YuKoLi自动化烹饪产线，标志着该地区厨房自动化商业化迈入重要里程碑。该项目总投资超过1200万美元，是YuKoLi在东南亚市场有史以来最大的单笔订单。

该连锁品牌在泰国、越南和柬埔寨运营三大业务板块——快餐、休闲餐饮和精致餐饮。引入YuKoLi自动化烹饪产线后，该品牌在中央厨房实现了从食材准备、自动烹饪到成品包装的全自动化生产，单店日均餐品产量提升3倍，人工成本降低65%。

项目分三期推进：第一期在30家旗舰店完成设备安装与调试，第二期覆盖剩余56家门店，第三期将上线YuKoLi云端管理平台，实现全网络的统一调度和数据分析。

该品牌运营总监表示："YuKoLi设备在试用期间表现优异，菜品品质的高度一致性显著提升了顾客满意度。更重要的是，YuKoLi团队提供了全面的售后服务和技术支持，让我们在整个部署过程中充满信心。"

YuKoLi东南亚区域总监透露，该项目的成功实施为公司在该地区的扩张奠定了坚实基础。来自多个国家的多家餐饮企业正在洽谈类似的大规模自动化项目，预计2026年下半年将迎来新一轮订单。

news_3_body:
经过为期六个月的严格审核和现场检查，YuKoLi全线产品成功获得ISO 9001:2015国际质量管理体系认证和欧盟CE安全合规认证，标志着公司在质量管控和国际市场准入能力方面迈上了重要台阶。

ISO 9001:2015认证要求企业在质量管理的各个方面达到国际标准，包括研发设计、生产制造、供应链管理和售后服务。审核机构对YuKoLi的质量管理体系给予了高度评价，特别认可公司在原材料溯源、标准化生产过程管控和出厂前产品检验等方面的严谨态度。

CE认证是欧盟强制性市场准入要求，涉及电气安全、机械安全、电磁兼容等多个维度的严格测试。YuKoLi所有智能烹饪设备均顺利通过各项测试，证明产品在安全性和可靠性方面已达到世界一流水平。

YuKoLi质量管理总监表示："获得双认证是我们长期坚持质量至上战略的重要成果。我们在质量管理体系建设方面投入了大量资源，从供应商筛选到最终产品交付，每一个环节都有严格的标准和流程。这些认证不仅是对我们现有工作的认可，更是持续改进的动力。"

YuKoLi目前正在推进美国UL认证和日本JIS认证的申请工作，预计将于2026年底完成。届时，公司将形成覆盖全球主要市场的完整认证体系，为进一步拓展国际市场提供有力支撑。

sr_pain2_title: TRANSLATE: Kitchen Too Small for Equipment
sr_pain2_body: TRANSLATE: A 10–15 m² kitchen has to fit prep tables, stoves, and a packing area. Traditional gas ranges turn the whole kitchen into an oven in summer — staff can barely stand it.
sr_pain3_title: TRANSLATE: New Chef Means New Flavor
sr_pain3_body: TRANSLATE: Regulars come for your signature taste. Today Chef A cooks it, tomorrow Chef B — the regular takes one bite and asks "Did you change chefs?" That's how you lose customers.
sr_pain4_title: TRANSLATE: Bottlenecked at Peak Service Speed
sr_pain4_body: TRANSLATE: At 11:30, delivery and dine-in orders flood in simultaneously. Two woks can't keep up. Customers wait 20 minutes with no food — they cancel the order, and bad reviews arrive the next day.
sr_pain5_title: TRANSLATE: Kitchen Like a Furnace, Monthly Bills Shocking?
sr_pain5_body: TRANSLATE: Open-flame kitchens hit 40°C+ in summer. Staff can only endure 2 hours. Gas cylinders need replacing several times a month, electricity bills keep climbing — that's how profits get eaten.
sr_pain6_title: TRANSLATE: Equipment Breaks = Business Stops, No One to Fix It?
sr_pain6_body: TRANSLATE: At noon the stove breaks down. The next batch is prepped but can't cook. You call the supplier — they say 3–5 days. How do you serve for the next 3 days?
sr_solution_title: TRANSLATE: How to Survive the Lunch Rush in a 15 m² Kitchen?
sr_solution_desc: TRANSLATE: The answer isn't hiring more people — it's letting equipment do the work reliably. No chef needed, no large kitchen required. Set up the equipment and start serving.
sr_feat1_body: TRANSLATE: Countertop wok, induction cooker, stewing machine — fried rice, char kway teow, fried chicken, braised pork, all done on the countertop. No floor space needed.
sr_feat2_body: TRANSLATE: Nasi Goreng, Pad Thai, fried rice, braised pork — 1,000+ recipes with preset heat and stir-fry timing. Same flavor regardless of who operates.
sr_feat3_body: TRANSLATE: Temperature and timing are machine-controlled. No more burnt or undercooked dishes. New operators are independent in 30 minutes.
sr_feat4_body: TRANSLATE: Start with the XC60. As daily orders grow, upgrade to larger capacity models — no need to invest everything upfront. Add a unit when orders increase.

sr_eq1_body: TRANSLATE: The first unit for any small restaurant. Fits on a countertop, serves fast — standard dishes ready in ~3 minutes. During peak, alternate between two woks.
sr_eq2_body: TRANSLATE: Soups, braised dishes, pre-prepared meals. Stew before service and hold in the insulated unit — serve directly at lunch without occupying the wok.
sr_eq3_body: TRANSLATE: Fried chicken, french fries, snacks — if your menu has fried items, you need this. Precise temperature, reliable batches every time.
sr_eq6_body: TRANSLATE: Only needed at 300+ daily orders. Large single-batch capacity — fewer flips, dozens more orders during peak.
sr_eq4_body: TRANSLATE: All ingredients cut and prepped 10 minutes before peak. The wok handles cooking — one person can run the whole show.
sr_eq5_body: TRANSLATE: Consider this when daily orders exceed 150. Larger capacity means fewer batches during peak — dozens more orders per shift.

sr_scenario_1_desc: TRANSLATE: No dine-in, delivery only. The kitchen just needs to cook fast and pack fast. One wok + one insulated server, 1–2 people is enough.
sr_scenario_2_desc: TRANSLATE: Dine-in and delivery at the same time — the kitchen must cook for both. Wok for mains, fryer for sides, stewing pot for soups — three lines running independently.

support_faq_cat_1_q1: TRANSLATE: How do I choose the right commercial kitchen equipment?
support_faq_cat_1_a1: TRANSLATE: Consider these factors: 1) Cuisine type — induction wok ranges for Chinese stir-fry, ovens and fryers for Western baking, food processors for fast-casual prep; 2) Daily output — estimate capacity based on daily covers; 3) Kitchen footprint — countertop models save space, floor-standing units offer higher throughput; 4) Power supply — confirm whether your site has 220 V or 380 V. Submit your requirements via our Get a Quote page and our engineers will recommend the optimal configuration.
support_faq_cat_1_q2: TRANSLATE: What is the difference between 220 V and 380 V equipment? How do I choose?
support_faq_cat_1_a2: TRANSLATE: 220 V (single-phase) suits small restaurants, cafés, and food stalls — plugs into standard mains power with easy installation. 380 V (three-phase) is designed for large commercial kitchens, central kitchens, and canteens where higher power, faster heating, and greater efficiency are needed; requires a certified electrician for installation. Our engineers conduct an on-site power survey before installation if you are unsure.
support_faq_cat_1_q3: TRANSLATE: Countertop vs. floor-standing equipment — which should I choose?
support_faq_cat_1_a3: TRANSLATE: Countertop units are compact and flexible, ideal for small kitchens with limited space; lower daily output and more budget-friendly. Floor-standing units deliver higher capacity and stability for mid-to-large commercial and central kitchens, typically with larger bowls and more powerful motors. Recommendation: kitchens under 30 m² should prioritize countertop equipment; above 30 m², choose floor-standing based on throughput needs. We provide complimentary layout planning for full-line configurations.

Daily inspection: Clear filters and drains; check blades and drive components. Weekly maintenance: Lubricate moving parts with food-grade oil; inspect power cables. Monthly deep clean: Fully disassemble and wash internal components; check consumable wear; perform function tests. Refer to the maintenance chapter of your operation manual for detailed schedules.

support_faq_cat_3_a4: TRANSLATE: Won't start: 1) Check power connection; 2) Verify main switch and equipment switch; 3) Check for error codes on display. Shuts down during operation: 1) Overheat protection may have triggered — wait 10 minutes to cool, then restart; 2) Check water/oil levels; 3) Inspect power cables for looseness. sr_hero_subtitle: TRANSLATE: Whether you run a delivery-only shop, community fast food, specialty store, or cloud kitchen — Southeast Asian small restaurants all face the same problem: the kitchen can't keep up, staff keep leaving. Which one are you?
sr_pain1_body: TRANSLATE: Experienced Southeast Asian chefs command high salaries — and the ones you train just leave. One sick day and the kitchen is paralyzed. Delivery orders pile up, dine-in customers wait, bad reviews follow.
support_faq_hero_desc: TRANSLATE: Equipment issue? Our intelligent FAQ system helps you find solutions fast. 80% of common issues are resolved instantly online; complex problems are automatically escalated to specialist engineers with end-to-end tracking until resolution.
support_faq_cat_1_a4: TRANSLATE: Yes. We offer OEM badging and ODM co-development partnerships. Customization covers exterior design, feature configuration, dimensional specifications, and control systems. Typical lead time is 30–60 working days depending on complexity. Contact our sales team via WhatsApp or email to discuss your customization requirements.
support_faq_cat_2_a1: TRANSLATE: Follow these steps for first use: 1) Inspect for shipping damage inside and out; 2) Verify voltage matches the nameplate before powering on; 3) Run idle for 5–10 minutes on first power-up and check for anomalies; 4) Familiarize yourself with buttons and parameter settings via the operation manual; 5) Clean the interior before putting into service. Our engineers provide on-site training during installation to ensure your staff can operate proficiently.
support_faq_cat_2_a2: TRANSLATE: Yes. YuKoLi smart devices support custom recipe import via USB or Wi-Fi. Create recipes on the control panel by setting temperature, time, stirring speed and other parameters, then save as preset programs. We also provide a built-in recipe library covering Chinese stir-fry, Western baking, Southeast Asian cuisines and more. Contact technical support for the recipe management tool if you need batch import.
support_faq_cat_2_a3: TRANSLATE: YuKoLi commercial equipment is designed for 24/7 continuous operation. We recommend a short rest and cleaning every 8–12 hours to maintain peak performance and extend service life. Built-in overheat protection automatically shuts down the unit if temperature exceeds safe limits; restart after cooling.
support_faq_cat_3_a2: TRANSLATE: Order through these channels: 1) Spare Parts Support page on this website; 2) WhatsApp our parts specialist; 3) Email sales.kitchen@yukoli.com. We stock 500+ genuine spare part SKUs in our Southeast Asia regional warehouse with 48-hour dispatch for standard parts. Provide your equipment model and photos of the required part to ensure precise matching.
support_faq_cat_4_a2: TRANSLATE: YuKoLi products are exported to 68+ countries and regions worldwide, with a focus on Southeast Asia including Thailand, Vietnam, Malaysia, Indonesia, the Philippines, Singapore, Myanmar, and Cambodia. We also export to the Middle East, Africa, and South America. All export equipment carries CE, ISO, ROHS and other international certifications meeting import standards worldwide. Contact our sales team to confirm specific country availability.
